'''The Crash''' was the place where the ''[[Tachyon Flier]]'' crashed, in [[Yoggoy]]. The ''Flier'' was being piloted by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Lomi Plo]] and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Welk]]. The two darksiders had stolen the ship from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Lowbacca]] and [[Raynar Thul]] was still aboard when they took off. The three survived the collision, albeit with severe injuries, and started to establish their influence over the Killiks. Eventually, the crash site became something of a holy place for the Killiks.

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] visited this place while searching for [[the Colony]].
